d:
The Rockets defeated the Warriors, 115-105 tonight in Houston. Kevin Durant finished with a team-high 20 points along with 5 assists and 4 rebounds for the Rockets, while Alperen Sengun tallied 19 points, 13 rebounds and 9 assists in the game. Yaxel Lendeborg recorded 25 points, 10 rebounds and 2 steals. The Rockets improve their record to 9-3 with the win, while the Warriors fall to 8-4 for the season.
